paper.title: NSFuzz: Towards Efficient and State-Aware Network Service Fuzzing
paper.authors: Shisong Qin, Fan Hu, Zheyu Ma, Bodong Zhao, Tingting Yin, and Chao Zhang
paper.venue: ACM Transactions on Software Engineering and Methodology 32(6), Article 160
paper.source_path: /mnt/c/Users/PC-123/Zotero/storage/UA5H6BBW/Qin 等 - 2023 - NSFuzz Towards efficient and state-aware network service fuzzing.pdf

blocks.original_text: Existing network-service fuzzers have insufficient or inaccurate state representation and low testing efficiency.
blocks.translation: 现有网络服务模糊测试器面临状态表示不充分或不准确，以及测试效率低的问题。

blocks.original_text: NSFuzz combines program-variable-based state representation with efficient interaction synchronization, static analysis, annotation APIs, and compile-time instrumentation.
blocks.translation: NSFuzz 将基于程序变量的状态表示与高效交互同步、静态分析、标注 API 和编译期插桩结合起来。

blocks.original_text: The same request may produce different responses in different session states, and many bugs require a specific message sequence.
blocks.translation: 同一请求在不同会话状态下可能产生不同响应，而且许多缺陷只能由特定消息序列触发。

blocks.original_text: A fixed delay is needed by prior tools because they lack a clear message-processing signal; a delay that is too short loses messages and one that is too long wastes time.
blocks.translation: 以往工具因缺少明确的消息处理完成信号而依赖固定等待；等待过短会丢消息，过长则浪费时间。

blocks.original_text: AFLnet response codes can be absent or ambiguous, StateAFL approximates complex in-memory state with locality-sensitive hashing, and SGFuzz may retain irrelevant enum variables.
blocks.translation: AFLnet 的响应码可能缺失或有歧义；StateAFL 用局部敏感哈希近似复杂内存状态；SGFuzz 可能把无关枚举变量误作状态变量。

blocks.original_text: NSFuzz treats selected program variables as semantic service-state carriers and the network event loop as a natural synchronization boundary.
blocks.translation: NSFuzz 把筛选后的程序变量作为具有语义的服务状态载体，并把网络事件循环视为天然同步边界。

blocks.original_text: Network services are organized into initialization, persistent request processing in an event loop, and cleanup stages.
blocks.translation: 网络服务通常由初始化、事件循环中的持续请求处理，以及清理三个阶段组成。

blocks.original_text: Re-entering the event loop indicates that the previous request has been processed and the service is ready for the next request.
blocks.translation: 服务重新进入事件循环意味着上一条请求已处理完成，并已准备接收下一条请求。

blocks.original_text: Bftpd uses an enumerated global variable named state to distinguish session states even when failure responses share the same 503 response code.
blocks.translation: Bftpd 使用全局枚举变量 state 区分会话状态，即使不同状态下的失败响应都使用相同的 503 响应码。

blocks.original_text: The four components are static analysis, annotation API, compile-time instrumentation, and the fuzzing loop.
blocks.translation: NSFuzz 的四个组成部分是静态分析、标注 API、编译期插桩和模糊测试循环。

blocks.original_text: A probe reaches input-related system calls, records a backtrace, and the static analyzer chooses the first outer function on that trace that contains an I/O loop.
blocks.translation: 探测请求触发输入相关系统调用并记录回溯；静态分析器随后选择回溯中第一个包含 I/O 循环的外层函数。

blocks.original_text: Candidates are restricted to the event-loop region, must be both loaded and stored, and must be global integer variables or structure members assigned constant values.
blocks.translation: 候选变量被限制在事件循环相关区域内，必须同时被读取和写入，并且是被常量赋值的全局整数变量或结构体成员。

blocks.original_text: Manual annotations handle multi-level or event-driven loops and refine false-positive state-variable candidates.
blocks.translation: 人工标注用于处理多层或事件驱动循环，并剔除状态变量候选中的误报。

blocks.original_text: _NSFUZZ_SYNC marks one or more locations so exactly one synchronization signal is emitted after each request is processed.
blocks.translation: _NSFUZZ_SYNC 标记一个或多个位置，使每条请求处理完后恰好产生一次同步信号。

blocks.original_text: _NSFUZZ_STATE can annotate global variables and structure-member variables selected to represent service state.
blocks.translation: _NSFUZZ_STATE 可标注被选作服务状态表示的全局变量和结构体成员变量。

blocks.original_text: shared_state[hash(var_id)] = cur_store_val
blocks.translation: 每次状态变量写入时，以变量唯一 ID 的哈希为索引，把当前写入值更新到 shared_state。

blocks.original_text: Instrumentation inserts raise(SIGSTOP) at synchronization points; NET_FORKSERVER uses waitpid to distinguish a synchronization stop from a crash and reports status through a pipe.
blocks.translation: 插桩在同步点插入 raise(SIGSTOP)；NET_FORKSERVER 通过 waitpid 区分同步停止与崩溃，并经管道向 fuzzer 报告状态。

blocks.original_text: The hash of the complete shared_state buffer is used as the current service-state identifier, and successive identifiers form a state-transition sequence.
blocks.translation: 完整 shared_state 缓冲区的哈希被用作当前服务状态标识，连续的状态标识构成状态转移序列。

blocks.original_text: NSFuzz updates the state-transition model and performs state-guided seed selection and message mutation similarly to AFLnet.
blocks.translation: NSFuzz 更新状态转移模型，并以与 AFLnet 类似的方式执行状态引导的种子选择和消息变异。

blocks.original_text: The evaluation asks five questions about throughput, state-model accuracy, overall effectiveness, state-space coverage, and real-world bug finding.
blocks.translation: 实验围绕吞吐量、状态模型准确性、总体有效性、状态空间覆盖和真实漏洞发现五个问题展开。

blocks.original_text: All 13 ProFuzzBench services were tested in separate Docker containers for 24 hours per run, four runs per configuration, totaling 6,240 CPU-hours.
blocks.translation: 实验覆盖 ProFuzzBench 的全部 13 个服务；每个配置在独立 Docker 容器中运行 24 小时并重复 4 次，总计 6,240 CPU 小时。

blocks.original_text: The event loop was identified by the analyzer in 9 of 13 services; manual synchronization-point adaptation took several minutes to at most two hours for unfamiliar users.
blocks.translation: 分析器在 13 个服务中的 9 个识别出事件循环；对不熟悉目标的使用者，人工同步点适配耗时从数分钟到最多两小时。

blocks.original_text: Relative to AFLnet, NSFuzz reports throughput improvements from about 1.8 times to more than 200 times, with a reported average improvement of about 24 times.
blocks.translation: 相对 AFLnet，NSFuzz 报告的吞吐提升从约 1.8 倍到超过 200 倍，平均约 24 倍。

blocks.original_text: State variables were automatically extracted for 9 services; annotation was used to remove configuration flags and message-type false positives or to handle unsupported services.
blocks.translation: 9 个服务可自动提取状态变量；人工标注用于去除配置标志、消息类型等误报，或处理静态分析不支持的服务。

blocks.original_text: For LightFTP, all four runs produced the same five-vertex, eleven-edge model: four Access values plus one initial dummy state.
blocks.translation: 对 LightFTP，四次运行均得到同一个 5 顶点、11 边模型：Access 的四个取值加一个初始虚拟状态。

blocks.original_text: The paper's direct semantic accuracy argument is a manual LightFTP case study; the other targets are mainly compared by graph size.
blocks.translation: 论文对语义准确性的直接证据主要来自 LightFTP 的人工案例分析；其他目标主要比较模型图规模。

blocks.original_text: NSFuzz improved final branch coverage over AFLnet on all 13 targets, averaging 7.23% and reaching 25.82% on TinyDTLS; NSFuzz-V averaged 2.11%.
blocks.translation: NSFuzz 在 13 个目标上的最终分支覆盖均高于 AFLnet，平均提升 7.23%，TinyDTLS 上最高 25.82%；NSFuzz-V 平均提升 2.11%。

blocks.original_text: Across the benchmark runs, NSFuzz triggered 19 crash clusters corresponding to 11 manually analyzed vulnerabilities, compared with 14/9 for AFLnet.
blocks.translation: 在基准实验中，NSFuzz 触发 19 个崩溃簇，经人工分析对应 11 个漏洞；AFLnet 为 14 个崩溃簇、9 个漏洞。

blocks.original_text: NSFuzz reached the first crash faster on Dnsmasq, TinyDTLS, and Live555, but not Dcmtk; on Dcmtk it nevertheless triggered a crash in all four runs.
blocks.translation: NSFuzz 在 Dnsmasq、TinyDTLS 和 Live555 上更快触发首个崩溃，但在 Dcmtk 上并非如此；不过它在 Dcmtk 的四次运行中都能触发崩溃。

blocks.original_text: The denominator for state-space coverage is the union of state-variable values reached by all fuzzers in all runs, not an independently known complete state space.
blocks.translation: 状态空间覆盖率的分母是所有 fuzzer 在全部运行中触发过的状态变量取值并集，而不是独立已知的完整状态空间。

blocks.original_text: Average state-space coverage was 91.12% for AFLnet, 73.13% for AFLnwe, 92.17% for StateAFL, 96.21% for NSFuzz-V, and 98.50% for NSFuzz.
blocks.translation: 平均状态空间覆盖率分别为 AFLnet 91.12%、AFLnwe 73.13%、StateAFL 92.17%、NSFuzz-V 96.21%、NSFuzz 98.50%。

blocks.original_text: A two-week campaign reported eight zero-day vulnerabilities: five in TinyDTLS and three in Dcmtk; at submission two were fixed, one more was confirmed, and five were only reported.
blocks.translation: 两周长期实验报告了 8 个零日漏洞：TinyDTLS 5 个、Dcmtk 3 个；投稿时其中 2 个已修复、另 1 个已确认，其余 5 个仅处于已报告状态。

blocks.original_text: The authors acknowledge that NSFuzz still uses AFLnet's seed-selection and mutation procedure and lacks a stronger mechanism for exploiting state feedback.
blocks.translation: 作者承认 NSFuzz 仍采用 AFLnet 的种子选择和变异流程，尚缺少更强的状态反馈利用机制。

blocks.original_text: SnapFuzz pursues the same waiting-time reduction goal through binary rewriting and a custom protocol, but it was discussed rather than experimentally compared.
blocks.translation: SnapFuzz 也以消除等待开销为目标，但采用二进制重写和自定义交互协议；论文只讨论了它，没有进行实验对比。

blocks.original_text: Future work is to improve state-space-guided seed selection and add format-aware message mutation.
blocks.translation: 未来工作是改进状态空间引导的种子选择，并加入格式感知的消息变异。
